feeds.title: Metal Underground
feeds.description: METAL UNDERGROUND WEBZINE AUSTRIA is an online music magazine that has been focusing on heavy metal, death metal, black metal, power metal, hard rock, hardcore, metalcore, grindcore, punk, and other rock / metal-related genres since 2003. Stay up to date with the latest news, CD, and DVD reviews, interviews, live reports, tour dates, stories, and competitions!

feeds.title: skug » Music
feeds.description: skug is an online magazine that deals openly with historical and current developments in the field of music and culture.

feeds.title: Demonic-Nights
feeds.description: The rock and metal webzine with news, CD reviews, interviews, Spotify playlists, raffles, list of new releases.

feeds.title: Earshot
feeds.description: Earshot is an Austrian online music magazine for metal and rock fans. With the latest news, live reports, interviews, and much more. You always stay up to date with the latest developments in the scene.

feeds.title: Heavypop.at
feeds.description: Heavypop.at aims to comment on current events in the music business by means of sound carrier and concert reviews, interviews and other articles (and also to pay special attention to what is happening in and around Graz).

feeds.title: Klangskizzerei
feeds.description: Austrian alternative music blog with sketched reviews, concert impressions, interviews, artist portraits.

feeds.title: subtext.at » Music
feeds.description: We are present everywhere and have become one of the most important cultural magazines in the country. We have already written thousands of articles - from concerts all over Europe to partnerships with established festivals to live reports at home and abroad - everything is included.

feeds.title: Wienkonzert
feeds.description: A music blog based in Vienna/Austria. Mostly concert-previews & reviews.

feeds.title: Soundmagnet
feeds.description: Soundmagnet, the attractive metal magazine, is a non-profit online magazine with the aim of promoting art and culture, especially music, here again rock and metal as a niche with the help of publishing articles and making them accessible to a broad readership.

feeds.title: Musikpics.at
feeds.description: In our blog we want to share with you where music will be made in the near future that might interest us, give you tips and give you a few photos to give you a look back at the concerts we have been to ourselves. Because we particularly enjoy listening to music from Austria live, our focus is on Austrian artists.

feeds.title: Austrian Music Export
feeds.description: Austrian Music Export is a service and resource center for exporters of contemporary Austrian music in all genres and aspects (recordings, live, sync, etc.). This includes providing access to information on Austrian artists and companies, building a substantial network of industry professionals and media, providing travel support and representing Austrian music at international trade shows, conferences and festivals.

feeds.title: Mica Music Austria
feeds.description: Mica Music Austria is the professional partner for musicians in Austria. It was founded in 1994 as an independent, non-profit association on the initiative of the Republic of Austria.
